notes.title: Bugfixes and Updates
notes.content:
Howdy All!

We have uploaded and released the latest build!

Feature improvements to Version 0.0.6:
    Fixed saving files
    Updated minimap
    Updated inventory to do paging
    Updated letter creator to sort people by name and note when no illegal activities are seen
    Updated the speech bubbles
    Updated ceiling collider
    Created light shadows
    Created a tutorial
    Added Steam achievements
    Added setting page, screen resolutions
    Added labels in notebook
    You start with pen and paper in your home.
    Other minor updates

Once again thank you for all the work you put into testing for us! We couldn't do it without you. Keep it up and we will continue improving as time goes on.

Thank you and happy new year,
Airy the Dragon
DaDarkWizard
